regime_context: The detector shows resource leadership concentrated in Base Metals & Copper and Gold Miners, both with full participation (breadth 1.0) and durable trends. Rotation is broad but non-directional, and the absolute-trend gate has historically helped control drawdowns in this market, though cross-sectional momentum rank has no forward alpha. The macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled news (99% share), adding uncertainty, so disciplined risk-awareness is warranted.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme holds the top rank with the highest relative flow focus, full breadth (1.0) indicating all constituents participate, durability above the trend-viability threshold (0.7), and is not crowded. Combined with the validated absolute-trend gate, this suggests the theme can sustain above-median participation while reducing drawdown risk, though the rank itself is not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Commodity demand could reverse if macro uncertainty spikes further; copper prices may have front-run a soft landing, and the high unscheduled news share raises the risk of a sharp sentiment shift.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO total return underperforms S&P/TSX by more than 3% over the 20 trading days ending 2026-08-27.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Second in rank with a higher durability score (0.79) and a Hurst exponent signaling trend continuity, alongside full breadth and no crowding signal. This configuration aligns with the trend-gate discipline of staying with healthy, broad uptrends to manage downside, despite momentum rank having no forward return edge.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are sensitive to real yields and USD dynamics; a sudden shift in central bank policy expectations or risk-on rotation could undermine the group’s relative performance.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO total return trails S&P/TSX by more than 3% over the 20 trading days ending 2026-08-27.

theses.subject: Fertilizer, Chemicals & Forestry
theses.thesis: The theme exhibits a negative momentum score, low breadth (0.25), and durability below the typical trend-sustainability threshold (0.48). While the absolute-trend gate can help avoid severe drawdowns, the combination of weak internal participation and fading leadership makes it less attractive in a relative context, likely to underperform the broader market.
theses.dissent: A commodity-specific supply shock or a revival in agricultural-commodity demand could trigger a rapid mean-reversion bounce, and the low breadth might reflect a narrow but still healthy leadership if the laggards suddenly catch up.

falsifier.text: XMA.TO total return outperforms S&P/TSX by more than 2% over the 20 trading days ending 2026-08-27.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
